why: GPS puts the driver at the pickup from 07:48:20, and he cancelled 7 minutes after tapping I'm Here with the rider still upstairs, which meets the published no-show condition. Running late or asking the driver to wait longer is not an exception, so the $6.61 fee stands.

basis.quote: - The driver presses "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)

5. Remaining stationary and uncontactable after accepting a ride to trigger cancellation or waiting fees

why: The driver tapped I'm Here 630 m from the pickup and stayed there until he cancelled, so he never waited at the pick-up point as the no-show fee requires, while the rider was at the pin messaging and calling him. The $6.61 should be refunded (Ryde's published remedy is a $6.61 voucher).

basis.quote: - The driver presses "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to arrive at the pick-up point and cancels the trip (Rider NO SHOW and no trip completion)
1. Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data AND
2. Has waited for more than 3 mins

why: The driver was at the pickup per GPS and cancelled 3 min 15 s after tapping I'm Here, just past the 3-minute threshold, with the rider not yet there. The policy gives no extra time when a rider messages that they are close, so the fee stands, but only by 15 seconds.

basis.quote: "free_wait_time_min": 6
"no_show_threshold_min": 10

If you feel that you have been unfairly charged a Cancellation Fee, you may submit a fee waiver request via RydeHELP in our app within 30 days of the trip* and we will review your eligibility for a refund.
If you feel you were incorrectly charged a Cancellation Fee, you may contact Ryde in writing at [email protected] for assistance.

why: This trip carries its own policy (6-minute free wait, 10-minute no-show threshold), and the driver cancelled 5 min 10 s after arriving, before either ran out. The $4.50 should be reversed, even though Ryde's general 3-minute rule alone would have let it stand.

basis.quote: All cancellations made within 3 minutes of matching are not chargeable.
- Rider cancels after 3 minutes of matching OR
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.
You can cancel a trip at any time through the Ryde app, but may be charged a Cancellation Fee if you cancel after 3 minutes of matching with a driver.

why: The rider cancelled 3 min 20 s after being matched (the clock runs from the 08:02:40 match, not from booking), just outside the 3-minute free window, and the GPS shows the driver heading straight for the pickup. A longer ETA than the booking screen showed is not an exception, so the $6.61 stands.

basis.quote: All cancellations made > 15 minutes before the scheduled trip time are not chargeable.
All cancellations made more than 15 minutes before scheduled trip time are not chargeable.
Riders are guaranteed 3 minutes of grace period from the time of match and/or 15 minutes before scheduled time for Advance Trip Request before the Cancellation Fee kicks in.
If you are eligible, we will issue you a voucher** with a unique code worth $6.61 as a refund for the incurred Cancellation Charges.

why: The advance booking was accepted the night before and the rider cancelled at 06:12:30, 17.5 minutes before the 06:30 pickup, which is inside the free window. The driver having already set off does not make it chargeable, so the $6.61 should be refunded.

basis.quote: Riders may be charged a Waiting Time Fee of $5 at the end of the trip if:
- The driver presses "I'm Here", waits for > 3 minutes for the rider to board, and continues the trip (Rider boards and driver completes trip).
Waiting Time Fees begin to kick in after the driver waits for more than 3 minutes at the pick-up point for the rider to board.
1. Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data AND

why: The driver tapped I'm Here at the pickup (GPS within 7 m) and the rider boarded 6 min 40 s later, so the $5 Waiting Time Fee is allowed. The policy does not require the driver to warn the rider first.

basis.quote: Drivers are only allowed to indicate arrival and impose the Waiting Time Fee only if he/she:
1. Is at the pick-up location according to GPS data AND
2. Has waited for more than 3 mins
Waiting Time Fees begin to kick in after the driver waits for more than 3 minutes at the pick-up point for the rider to board.
If you are eligible, we will issue you a voucher** with a unique code worth $5.00 as a refund for the incurred Waiting Charges.

why: The driver tapped I'm Here about 370 m away while still moving and only reached the pickup at 20:37:20, and the rider boarded 1 min 30 s later. He never waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup, so the $5 Waiting Time Fee should be refunded.

basis.quote: The trip fare is fixed based on pick-up and drop-off points, hence the driver may decide to take the most efficient route according to GPS.
Fares quoted for our services are generally fixed, except for RydeTAXI.
All fares are fixed at the time of booking but does not include toll charges such as ERP.

why: This RydeX fare was fixed at $28.40 at booking and that is what was charged, with no ERP or other extra for the longer route, so the detour cost the rider nothing. The policy has no refund for a longer route on a fixed fare; the route choice can go to driver feedback.

basis.quote: Fares quoted for our services are generally fixed, except for RydeTAXI.
Do note that all fees for Standard and/or Premium Taxi Services follow that of the respective taxi company.
Key in the fare as indicated on your meter.
1. Overcharging riders or manipulating fares
Any complaints between Partners and Users must be taken up with each other directly.

why: RydeTAXI is metered, so the fixed-fare rule that settles detour claims on other services does not apply, and Ryde's published texts give no rule for refunding a metered detour paid in cash. A person has to weigh the 7.6 km detour (no incident on the PIE) against the driver's jam explanation and decide whether anything is refunded.

basis.quote: If a rider passes through an active ERP gantry, the toll charge will be applicable to the rider.
Please key in ERP based on the ERP gantry you passed during the journey.
Please bear in mind that if an additional/excessive amount is keyed in, this will be considered fraudulent and drivers will be liable for permanent suspension.
However, please note that there may be additional charges such as tolls that could occur during your trip.

why: The trip log shows one active gantry at $2.50, but the driver keyed in $8.50, so only $2.50 was chargeable. The extra $6.00 should be refunded, and the over-keyed amount is the kind of excessive ERP entry Ryde treats as fraud.

basis.quote: Vomit | Up to S$200
Reimbursement will be capped based on the applicable tier (up to S$200). Any excess amount will not be covered.
1. Your vehicle must be professionally cleaned within 24 hours from the incident
2. Submit your claim via the driver app within 48 hours from the affected trip
- At least one photo must show the vehicle's car plate number to verify the vehicle
Ryde may, subject to verification under its Vehicle Contamination Policy, reimburse the driver for the applicable cleaning costs and separately recover the amount from the rider.

why: Vomit is shown by drop-off photos (one with the plate) and admitted in the rider's own chat, and the car was professionally cleaned within 24 hours with a complete receipt and claimed within 48 hours. The $240 receipt is over the S$200 vomit cap, so the driver gets S$200, which Ryde recovers from the rider.

basis.quote: We have a zero-tolerance approach to any form of misconduct or inappropriate behavior between drivers and passengers.
Additionally, drivers must not ask overly personal questions, comment on anyone's appearance, or contact passengers after a trip for personal reasons.
Violations of these guidelines will result in immediate termination and legal action where applicable.
To report the driver, do send us a ticket via Rydehelp on your app to let us know the details.
Driver-partners will be given the opportunity to respond before final decisions are made, except in urgent or high-risk situations.

why: The rider reports personal questions, comments on her looks and contact after the trip (an in-app message on record plus a WhatsApp message), all of which the Code of Conduct forbids under its zero-tolerance rule. This is a safety matter, so a person must investigate and decide on the driver; no money ruling is requested.

basis.quote: The chat log & call driver option will only be available up to 24 hours from the time the trip ends.
Please provide us with the details in the blanks below via RydeHELP.
1. With the driver's consent, we will provide you with their contact number.
(We recommend a $25 minimum fare to compensate for the driver's time.)
Neither Ryde nor its drivers are responsible for the item(s) left behind in the vehicle after a trip.

why: No charge is disputed; this is a lost iPad reported more than 24 hours after the trip, so it follows the RydeHELP lost-and-found steps (driver checks, number shared with consent). Paying the driver for the return is a recommendation (minimum $25 suggested), not a charge for this system to rule on.

basis.quote: If you feel that you have been unfairly rated due to the additional fees imposed on riders, please write in using the RydeHELP feature on your app to submit your appeal.
Based on our Ratings and Review Moderation Policy, the team will review your appeal and consider removing ratings that are irrelevant to the driver's quality of service.
5. Commentary about past trips or drivers or about the Ryde product where it does not relate to the driver and the trip you are rating (Cashbacks, app UI/UX, Waiting Time Fee etc).
When we receive a report of a review that violates this policy, we may remove the review from our platform and reinstate your 5* rating.

why: No charge is disputed: the rider never challenged the $5 fee, which was valid after a 6 min 50 s wait. The driver wants a 1-star review about the Waiting Time Fee removed, which is a ratings-moderation appeal for support, and the policy favors removing it.
